title: Closing Settlement Working Basis for Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts
content:
The balance an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts closes at is everything the account still carries on the day it is closed.

## The quantities

**The amount standing on the account** is the fuel billed and the fees billed, less the payments posted, plus the money committed on the bookings the account carries, less the money applied against those bookings, whether on a fill drawn against them or on a release of gallons standing undrawn, rounded to two decimal places.

**The rate the closing balance bears** is the programme's monthly service charge.

**The base the closing charge is worked out on** is the amount standing on the account.

**The months the closing charge runs for.** The closing charge runs for one month.

**The closing allowance** is nothing.

**The closing charge** is the base at the rate the closing balance bears for the months the closing charge runs, rounded to two decimal places.

**The balance the account closes at** is the amount standing plus the closing charge less the closing allowance, rounded to two decimal places, and never falls below nothing.

The money taken off for what has been applied against the bookings takes in both kinds of entry alike: the money applied on a fill drawn against a booking and the money applied on a release of gallons standing undrawn both come off, and neither is left out. The base the charge is worked out on and the amount the charge is then added to are two separate figures, each named above in its own right. The rounding falls on the amount standing when it is assembled, on the closing charge when it is worked out, and on the closing balance at the end.

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

Take an account on a programme whose monthly service charge is 1.5 percent. Suppose it carries 3200.00 USD of fuel billed, 100.00 USD of fees billed, 1000.00 USD of payments posted, 1800.00 USD committed on the bookings it carries, and 2100.00 USD applied against those bookings, made up of 900.00 USD on fills drawn against them and 1200.00 USD on a release of gallons standing undrawn.

- The amount standing: 3200.00 plus 100.00, less 1000.00, plus 1800.00, less the whole 2100.00 applied against the bookings, coming to 2000.00 USD.
- The base the closing charge is worked out on: 2000.00 USD, the amount standing on the account.
- The months the closing charge runs for: one month.
- The closing charge: 2000.00 USD at 1.5 percent for one month, coming to 30.00 USD.
- The balance the account closes at: 2000.00 plus 30.00, less a closing allowance of nothing, coming to 2030.00 USD.
